description: Election Commission - Local Authorities Elections of 10th February 2018, The number of Overhanging members of each Local Authority Endicated of the district and Local Auhority
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to electoral processes, specifically the determination of overhanging members for local authorities following an election held on 10th February 2018. It is published by the Election Commission under the Local Authorities Election Ordinance and provides election-related data (number of overhanging members per local authority), making it clearly fall under the Elections category.
